description: Two buffered multiples, three copies of the upper input and two of the lower, joined by a bus that carries across from one Bus Mult to the next

inputs.text: The source for the three jacks below it; with nothing patched it takes the bus from a Bus Mult placed immediately to its left
The source for the two jacks below it, taking the upper input when nothing is patched here

outputs.text: A copy of the upper input
A copy of the lower input

notes: Whatever the lower half is carrying is passed along to a Bus Mult placed immediately to the right, where it feeds that module's upper half if its own jack is empty.

inputs.0:
one channel only

unpatched it reads the chained BusMult to the left.
inputs.1:
one channel only

unpatched it reads the 1 input.
